summary: M6_2K_SECURITY_REVIEW (mode=analysis_only). Security/PII review of the FINAL slice M6.2K 'Smoke & Evidence Pack' — the full-P0-matrix re-run + doc §22 owner sign-off package assembler. In-scope rule M6-RULE-015 (executors write evidence, never self-certify); in-scope fail gate M6-FAIL-007 (No evidence = calling PASS without audit/evidence/smoke). ENTRY GATE verified in the state ledger before review: M6-P2006=RUNNING (row 184, order 182, DependsOn=M6-P2005); M6-P2005=PASS (boundary adversary, 43 executed vectors, 0 FAIL-007 breach); M6-P2004=PASS (TESTER_RUN full staged suite 523 passed/0 failed RC0, 18 evidence legs 72/72); entry-gate judge M6-P2000=SIGNED chaining to M6.2J slice-gate judge M6-P1909=SIGNED; IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_LOCKED.json LOCKED, staged-only. SCOPE: M6.2K carries the whole M6.2J app forward byte-identical and adds ONE package, the read-only send-less evidence-pack assembler app/measurement/evidence/ (smoke_registry/categories/models/gap_blockers/pack_assembler); it adds no new identity handling, no egress, no endpoint. METHOD: an independent masking scanner (work/pii_scan_2k.py) walked 234 files (impl/M6.2K app + all tests, test-reports/M6.2K, boundary-reports/M6.2K_boundary.md, prior evidence M6-P2000..2005), masking every hit; plus a line-level read of the new evidence package, the carried hasher integration/hash_policy.py, both SMK-017 legs, config.py, and the API surface. SCAN RESULT: EMAIL 0, VN_PHONE 0, DIGIT_RUN_9_19 0, PSID_LITERAL 0, REAL keyword=VALUE credential assignments 0, REAL high-entropy tokens (risk-* excluded) 0. The only 3 SECRET regex hits are the sk- substring inside the word risk-accept* (README risk-accepted; consumed.py/validator.py risk-acceptance) — governance waiver prose, carried byte-identical from M6.2A, verified line-by-line; the risk-excluding real-token count is the authoritative discriminator and is 0. Zero raw phone/email/address/customer_id/guest_id/psid/token/password/API-key anywhere in the slice. EVIDENCE-PACKAGE PII/EXPORT ANALYSIS: models carry only governance data (smoke ids, category names, gap ids like M6-OD-011/M6-P1000, statuses); correlation/evidence ids are synthetic (corr_0NN/ev_0NN) and masked at the export choke SmokeResult.to_public() via the central mask() (RULE-014/H02), asserted by the two SMK-017 evidence legs (masked != raw; raw id absent from the public blob); posture snapshot is a read-only MappingProxyType, EvidencePack is frozen; the assembler exposes no pass/ready/certify/sign_off/approve/enable/flag-flip verb and writes no enabling value; the 8 standing gap/blockers are always disclosed (governance refs only, no PII) and readiness is fail-closed NOT_READY on any incomplete category or un-recorded smoke, topping at OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED (no Pass/Ready member exists). HASH POLICY / M6-OD-003: N/A for the assembler (it sends nothing) — the same honest N/A as A/B/C/E/F/G/H/I/J (OD-003 blocks a review only when the slice deliverable IS external-send hashing, i.e. M6.2D), NOT a BLOCKED. M6.2K uniquely surfaces hash policy honestly in two places: category 9 SECURITY_PRIVACY requires a hash_policy evidence key (records status, not a pass), and SMK-017 (proposed, executed) exercises the carried fail-closed hasher (raw allow-list frozenset() empty, HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False, so to_public_safe hashes every identity value h_<sha256> and the raw branch is unreachable). The behavioral SMK-017 leg assembles its raw-PII markers at runtime from fragments (no literal email/phone/user-id in source — why the scanner sees 0) and asserts no raw value in the payload or platform result log, every field hashed not dropped. The honesty point: a green SMK-017 proves the fail-closed MECHANISM (no raw PII ever leaves), NOT owner ratification of a send policy — and the pack preserves that distinction by disclosing M6-OD-003 OPEN in the M6.2G-SCALE standing blocker, so the green smoke cannot be misread as cleared-to-send. CONSENT: the assembler has no consent gate; category 2 + SMK-002/008 exercise the carried fail-closed ConsentGate + CRM/reactivation paths (reviewed at M6.2B/D/J); no new consent enforcement point, none weakened; the consumed CRM subject-bind gap (F-GROWTH-1/F-SEC-2J-1) stays disclosed in the M6.2J-GROWTH standing blocker. UNTRUSTED INPUT: nil channel surface — the assembler inputs are TESTER-authored smoke_results and PM-authored evidence_refs (trusted upstream roles); no comment/Messenger/ad-copy/form/CRM text flows into the pack; export to_public() masks the ids; the boundary F-EVID-1/2 residuals are trusted-input-only (need a hand-forged object the channel cannot supply). ACCESS CONTROL (doc §22 line 429): M6.2K adds NO API/admin/worker endpoint — grep across impl/M6.2K/app finds no app/api/* import or wiring of EvidencePackAssembler; the carried endpoints (dashboard/scale_requests/conversions) are unchanged and none serves the pack. The forward requirement — the eventual admin endpoint serving the owner package must authenticate/authorize the caller and the export masking must be complete — is disclosed IN the pack's own standing blockers M6-OD-011 (admin-endpoint authN/authZ) and M6-OD-012 (PII masking scope, OPEN). FINDINGS (all armed-not-fired; none channel-reachable; none trips FAIL-007; none is a live PII leak): F-SEC-2K-1 (primary) SmokeResult.to_public() masks correlation_id/evidence_id but exports status VERBATIM — the same export-masking-scope inconsistency family as F-SEC-2I-2 (funnel messenger_thread_id raw) and F-SEC-2J-2 (buyer_ref opt-in mask); trusted-input only (TESTER sets status=PASS/FAIL, confirmed at test_smk_017_p0_evidence_pack.py:48); fix enum-constrain status to {PASS,FAIL} or route through mask(); ratifies under the OPEN M6-OD-012 which the pack already discloses (= boundary F-EVID-4). F-SEC-2K-2 category completeness uses provided.get(k) truthiness not ref shape — a whitespace/truthy ref marks COMPLETE, and this applies to category 9 SECURITY_PRIVACY itself (its no_raw_pii/hash_policy/access_control keys could read COMPLETE from a blank ref); trusted-input only (PM authors refs at M6-P2007; this security review + the judge re-check ref content downstream); fix validate ref shape stripped-non-blank/existence (= boundary F-EVID-2). Cross-refs concurred (no PII scope, FAIL-007 hardening for CODER): F-EVID-1 (recorded trusts truthiness/duck values + verbatim-appended row can mislabel a displayed smoke — pin to spec.smoke_id + require non-blank status+correlation+evidence) and F-EVID-3 (no readiness<->standing-blocker positive floor; a code-exec rebind of pack_assembler.STANDING_GAP_BLOCKERS empties the payload while readiness stays OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED — assert the 8 STANDING_BLOCKER_IDS present; code-exec-only, not channel-reachable). CONSISTENCY: the pack already discloses every security-relevant forward condition I confirmed in prior slices — M6-OD-003 (via M6.2G-SCALE), M6-OD-011, M6-OD-012, F-SEC-2I-2 (M6.2I-FUNNEL), F-SEC-2J-* (M6.2J-GROWTH); the masking-scope family F-SEC-2I-2/F-SEC-2J-2/F-SEC-2K-1 all route to the single OPEN M6-OD-012. GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF, HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False, SCALE_MODEL_RATIFIED=False, SCALE_EXECUTION_ENABLED=False, LEARNING_AUTOPUBLISH_ENABLED=False. No application code/test/migration/state-ledger/release-flag change; no CRM send, no commission, no Data-Mart trigger, no Core override, no scale/publish, no order-state/pricing; no enabling value written anywhere. No raw secret/PII in this evidence (correlation/evidence ids referenced only in masked form; the SMK-017 runtime-assembled markers are described, never reproduced). status=PASS is my honest security self-report; it does NOT self-certify gate advancement (RULE-015) — the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge M6-P2009 decide closure.
